rationale: The agent authenticated the user (lookup by name/zip and fetching user details) and reviewed orders, but then executed an exchange action for two items in one call. Policy requires confirming every order-changing action before taking it; there is no evidence of user confirmation prior to the write. Moreover, the user explicitly instructed that if asked for confirmation, only the desk lamp should be exchanged; the agent exchanged both the water bottle and the lamp, violating the user’s condition. The final message also lacks clear confirmation details or next steps. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
